original_exclusion: Exclude all roots in the original audited prefix and the original 1024-root confirmation cohort, plus every target child object associated with those excluded roots.
structural_exclusion: Exclude roots sharing a target child with a different root, and roots crossing any excluded target child. This is a schema/partition-boundary exclusion, not selection by repair outcome or completeness; count all exclusions.
assignment: Rank remaining root identifiers by SHA256(namespace + ':' + domain + ':' + raw_root_id); allocate consecutive disjoint blocks in the order listed in partition_sizes.
record_contract: All events of selected roots, native allowed event fields only, no copied trace/object attributes or exposed canonical root/child IDs. Child histories stay with their root. Resources and vendors may overlap partitions.
freshness: New object histories from previously used source datasets; not new institutions, an independent population sample, or untouched source schema.
access: Development and annotation records may inform method development. Confirmation and native_comparison outcomes remain unopened until their separate method/evaluation freezes. Preparing graphs and checking schema/partition integrity is permitted.
fallback: Fail if a requested block is unavailable; record any amendment before replacement selection. Never choose a smaller or different cohort based on scores.
